language_shifts.shift: Revenue growth reversed: after Q1 +59.4M and Q2 +69.3M vs prior year, Q3 reported -11.3M vs prior year with no updated guidance or explanation provided.
Critical accounting hedge removed: Q1-Q3 included disclaimer about estimates based on management best knowledge; Q4 onward replaced with narrower procedural language.
Distribution reach quietly reduced: claimed over 100 countries in Q1-Q3, reduced to over 85 countries in Q4 onward with no disclosed reason.
ARR introduced as a new metric without prior-year baseline or target, potentially reframing business narrative without providing comparable data.

red_flags: R&D spending inconsistently stated: 15% in Q1, then 14% in Q2-Q3, then back to 15% in Q4-Q6 without explanation.
Q3 revenue declined year-over-year after two growth quarters with no guidance adjustment or commentary.
Distribution channel countries reduced from over 100 to over 85 starting Q4 with no disclosure.
No quantitative forward guidance provided across any of the 6 quarters - management avoided trackable numerical commitments.
Recurring revenue mix stalled at 58-59% in Q4-Q6 fiscal 2020 with slight regression from Q5 to Q6 not flagged.

notable_shifts.observation: MD&A included explicit epistemic hedge: Although these estimates are based on management s best knowledge of current events and actions that may impact the company in the future, actual results may be different from the estimates.

Best knowledge qualifier removed. Replaced with: Management believes that the Notes to the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements have had no significant changes - a narrower procedural statement reducing transparency about forecast uncertainty.

Mission language shifted from optimize the work processes of office and mobile field professionals around the world to enable professionals and field mobile workers to improve or transform their work processes, subtly broadening scope.

Customer segment changed from long haul trucking companies to trucking companies and from contractors, surveying companies to contractors, owners, surveying companies adding owners but removing long haul specificity.

ARR introduced as a new performance measure without prior-year comparison or numerical target; definition truncated in available text. Introduction of a new KPI mid-period without baseline is a communication ambiguity flag.

Software/recurring revenue mix reported at 58% (Q4), 59% (Q5), 58% (Q6). The slight decline from Q5 to Q6 was not flagged. Management presented this as continuing to experience a shift without noting the reversal.
